The '''2012–13 [[La Liga]]''' season (known as the ''Liga BBVA'' for sponsorship reasons) was the 82nd since its establishment. The campaign began on 18 August 2012, and concluded on 1 June 2013.<ref>{{cite news|title=La Liga comienza el 19 de agosto |trans-title=La Liga starts on 19 August |url=http://www.lfp.es/Noticias/Detallenoticia.aspx?IDNoticia=15215&l=ES |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120904152933/http://www.lfp.es/Noticias/Detallenoticia.aspx?IDNoticia=15215&l=ES |url-status=dead |archive-date=4 September 2012 |publisher=[[Liga de Fútbol Profesional|LFP]] |date=29 May 2012 |access-date=29 May 2012 }}</ref> [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] won the league for a 22nd time, after leading the league the entire season and amassing 100 points, equalling [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]]'s points record from the [[2011–12 La Liga|previous season]].

As in previous years, [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]] provided the official ball for all matches, with a new Nike Maxim Liga BBVA model to be used throughout the season for all matches.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nike MAXIM, La Liga and Serie A 2012/13 balls|url=http://pes-parche.com/2012/03/balones-nike-maxim-temporada-2012-2013-official-match-ball-full-hd.html|publisher=pes-parche.com|date=20 April 2012|access-date=20 April 2012|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120402171039/http://pes-parche.com/2012/03/balones-nike-maxim-temporada-2012-2013-official-match-ball-full-hd.html|archive-date=2 April 2012|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=El balón de la Liga |trans-title=La Liga ball|url=http://www.marca.com/2012/07/03/futbol/1adivision/1341351018.html|work=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|location=Spain |date=3 July 2012 |access-date=4 July 2012 |language=es}}</ref>

==Teams==
A total of 20 teams contested the league, including 17 sides from the [[2011–12 La Liga|2011–12 season]] and three promoted from the [[2011–12 Segunda División]]. This included the two top teams from the Segunda División, and the victorious team of the play-offs.

[[Villarreal CF]], [[Sporting de Gijón]] and [[Racing de Santander]] were relegated to [[2012–13 Segunda División]] the previous season: Villarreal were relegated after twelve years in [[La Liga]], Sporting de Gijón returned to Segunda División after a four-year tenure in La Liga, while Racing de Santander ended ten consecutive seasons in La Liga, the longest period in its history.

The three teams that were relegated were replaced by three [[2011–12 Segunda División]] sides: [[Deportivo de La Coruña]] made an immediate return to the top level as [[2011–12 Segunda División|Segunda División champion]]. The second-placing team [[Celta de Vigo]] was also promoted to La Liga after a five-year absence. The third promoted team was decided in the [[2012 Segunda División play-offs|promotion play-offs]] where [[Real Valladolid]] returned to La Liga after two seasons in Segunda División.

|note_res_ELGS=Since the [[2012–13 Copa del Rey]] champions Atlético Madrid and runners-up Real Madrid qualified for the [[2013–14 UEFA Champions League]], the 5th, 6th and 7th placed teams qualified for the group stage, play-off round, and third qualifying round of the 2013–14 UEFA Europa League respectively.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/MultimediaFiles/Download/Regulations/competitions/Regulations/01/94/62/40/1946240_DOWNLOAD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130514121404/http://www.uefa.com/MultimediaFiles/Download/Regulations/competitions/Regulations/01/94/62/40/1946240_DOWNLOAD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=14 May 2013|title=Regulations of the UEFA Europa League 2013/14|date=March 2013|publisher=UEFA|location=Nyon|access-date=1 May 2013}}</ref>
|result5=ELGS
|note_res_MCF=Málaga was excluded from participating in any UEFA club competition in 2013–14 season as a punishment for not complying with [[UEFA Financial Fair Play Regulations]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Malaga have second year of European ban waived by Uefa|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/22573330 |publisher=[[BBC]] |date=17 May 2013 |access-date=9 June 2013}}</ref> Málaga appealed against this UEFA ban, but the Court of Arbitration for Sport confirmed the decision of the UEFA Club Financial Control Body.<ref>{{cite news|title=UEFA welcomes CAS decision on Málaga |url=https://www.uefa.com/news-media/news/020a-0e850f5d674f-9a1d076d144f-1000--uefa-welcomes-cas-decision-on-malaga/ |publisher=[[UEFA]] |date=11 June 2013 |access-date=11 June 2013 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130614050019/http://www.uefa.com/uefa/footballfirst/matchorganisation/disciplinary/news/newsid%3D1962518.html |archive-date=14 June 2013 }}</ref>
|result6=MCF
|col_ELPO=blue2|text_ELPO=Qualification for the [[2013–14 UEFA Europa League qualifying phase and play-off round#Play-off round|Europa League play-off round]]
|note_res_ELPO=ELGS
|result7=ELPO
|note_res_RVA=Rayo Vallecano was excluded from participating in any UEFA club competition for the next season after RFEF denied them a "UEFA licence" because they didn't meet the requirements as they were immersed in a creditor contest.<ref name="licenciaUEFA">{{cite news |title=El Málaga obtiene la licencia UEFA; Rayo y Espanyol, aún no |trans-title=Málaga got the UEFA licence, Rayo and Espanyol, not still |url=http://futbol.as.com/futbol/2013/05/14/mas_futbol/1368551550_052026.html |publisher=[[Diario AS|As]] |date=14 May 2013 |access-date=14 May 2013}}</ref><ref name="licenciaUEFA2">{{cite news |title=El Betis ya tiene en su poder la licencia UEFA que la RFEF deniega al Rayo y al Espanyol |trans-title=Betis already has UEFA licence which RFEF denied to Espanyol and Rayo |url=http://elcorreoweb.es/2013/05/14/el-betis-ya-tiene-en-su-poder-la-licencia-uefa-que-la-rfef-deniega-al-rayo/ |publisher=El Correo de Andalucía |date=14 May 2013 |access-date=14 May 2013}}</ref> They appealed to [[Court of Arbitration for Sport|CAS]] in June 2013 and on 11 July that decision was confirmed. The team placed behind them, [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]], took their spot at the [[2013–14 UEFA Europa League#Third qualifying round|Europa League third qualifying round]].<ref>{{cite news |title=El TAS niega la licencia UEFA al Rayo y el Sevilla jugará en Europa |trans-title=CAS denies UEFA licence to Rayo and Sevilla will play in Europe |url=http://www.marca.com/2013/07/11/futbol/equipos/rayo/1373549331.html |language=es |work=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|location=Spain |date=11 July 2013 |access-date=12 July 2013}}</ref>

==Awards==

===La Liga Awards===
La Liga's governing body, the [[Liga de Fútbol Profesional|Liga Nacional de Fútbol Profesional]], honoured the competition's best players and coach with [[LFP Awards]].<ref>{{cite news |first=Peter J. |last=Mulroy |title=La Liga Awards 2013: Cristiano Ronaldo Earns MVP; Lionel Messi Wins Best Player and Best Forward for 5th Year |newspaper=Latin Times |date=3 December 2013 |url=http://www.latintimes.com/la-liga-awards-2013-cristiano-ronaldo-earns-mvp-lionel-messi-wins-best-player-and-best-forward-5th |access-date=8 March 2016}}</ref><ref name="2012–13">{{cite web|title=Messi, mejor delantero y mejor jugador; Cristiano, jugador más valioso |publisher=Liga de Fútbol Profesional |language=es |date=2 December 2013 |url=https://www.ligabbva.com/liga-bbva/126953/messi-mejor-delantero-y-mejor-jugador-cristiano-jugador-mas-valioso/ |access-date=8 March 2016 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151208113604/https://www.ligabbva.com/liga-bbva/126953/messi-mejor-delantero-y-mejor-jugador-cristiano-jugador-mas-valioso/ |archive-date= 8 December 2015 }}</ref>

===Zamora Trophy===
The [[Ricardo Zamora Trophy]] is awarded by newspaper ''[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]'' to the goalkeeper with the lowest ratio of goals conceded to matches played. A goalkeeper had to play at least 28 matches of 60 or more minutes to be eligible for the trophy.

===Fair Play award===
This award was given annually since 1999 to the team with the best fair play during the season. This ranking takes into account [[La Liga#Competition format|aspects]]<ref name="La Liga fair play rules"/><!-- defined by Template:Fb La Liga fair play award rules since 2001 --> such as cards, suspension of matches, audience behaviour and other penalties. This section not only aims to determine the best fair play, but also serves to break the tie in teams that are tied in all the other rules: points, head-to-head, goal difference and goals scored.
